title: GMI theme-graph capability row v1
description: One ROW of data/theme_graph/capability.parquet, as a JSON object. Rule capability.v1 (W3A §4, review amendment §9.3). A SIDE-CAR, never a node column: node rows are keep-first write-once, so a capability stored on the row would be a one-way ratchet whose first verdict outlived every later substrate improvement. Here rows are re-derived on every build and the current view is the max computed_at per node_id, so a classification can move in BOTH directions — which is what makes it a measurement rather than a label. INTERNAL: capability is never user-facing, never a market state, and never an input to a rank, size or gate.

node_id.description: The node this row classifies. Must resolve to a row in nodes.parquet (guard-enforced).

capability.description: measurement_candidate iff >=3 live members resolve to a price artifact — the definitional minimum for a cross-sectional aggregate to BE an aggregate, not an eligibility judgment. semantic_only otherwise, including every concept with no membership substrate. measurable is UNREACHABLE in W3A: it is minted by W3B after measurement, and a builder may not mint it by classifying.

capability_basis.description: Self-describing: the rule id, the counts, the membership path (direct source claim vs basket join — they are different facts) and the substrate that satisfied the rule. A reader must never have to re-derive why a node was classified the way it was.
